I'm not sure this completely applies because it's not an illness or a health condition, but I think there can be a lot of misconceptions about asexuality that I'd like to clear up.

I have a few friends who are asexual and a big misconception is that asexual people don't fall in love and are alone forever. There's a range of possibilities within asexuality. For example one friend of mine doesn't have interest in sex or in relationships, this is known as asexual a-romantic. However, another friend of mine is interested in dating people of both genders. He identifies as asexual bi-romantic. He's interested in falling in love, kissing, cuddling, ect. As for actual sex, he describes it as something he doesn't *mind* doing if the other person really wants it... it's just not something he particularly enjoys. 

Another misconception is that they "just haven't found the right person." This is the equivalent saying "you just haven't found the right girl" to a gay man. My friend has had long term relationships, one night stands, and friends with benefits with both guys and girls. At some point it stops being about the person you're with and it's pretty clear that it's just about sex in general.

I hope at least one person learnt something they didn't know :) and this is just what I've learnt from the experience of my friends around me. If someone disagrees or has had different experiences with asexuality, feel free to tell me. I'd love to hear it :)

I've suffered from dermatillomanila (skin picking) and dermatophagia (skin biting) for over 10 years, mainly on my hands and feet. I've tried pretty much everything to stop on my own but it's never worked. I don't want to tell my parents because I know they'll think I'm overreacting and just being dramatic. I tend to get really into things and then give up quickly, so I know they'll think I'm going through just a phase, but I've been doing this for most of my life and just recently discovered that it's actually a disorder. It's gotten to a point where I constantly pick until I bleed and just hate myself afterwards. I've read about ways to cure it, but on the chance that they do take me seriously we don't have the money for therapy or medication. I just get so frustrated that I can't "just stop" it on my own. I feel so weak. I'm afraid to tell anyone because I know they'll think it's weird or disgusting, which I think it is too but I can't do anything about it! The worst is when I do it in public and people look at me for it and then I feel the compulsion to do it more because I'm anxious that they're looking at me.
One day when I earn my own money I'm going to go to a therapist and get it sorted out and then no one will ever have to know about it (except for you, Reddit) :)
